resources.string: Note: Do we even need a scroll view? Depends on how many groups we plan to preview, I guess. This is a very long string to test the scroll view, even though Im not sure how it will work if we want to actually put enrolled groups views in there. For now this will serve as a placeholder to show the scrolling functionality, and we will work on the groups view once we can successfully navigate around the app and see/join/manage groups. This is more of a quality of life feature than a real feature, so it should not take excessive priority over the actual functionality of the application.
